overview: Incumbent Emily Lazzaro presents her platform for re-election to the City Council, emphasizing her record on civil rights, pedestrian safety, and school infrastructure. She outlines priorities for a second term including fire department funding, zoning reform for business districts, and equitable school fundraising.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Background
items.summary: Emily Lazzaro introduces her background as a writer, parent, and advocate seeking a second term on the City Council.

items.title: Legislative Record and Public Safety
items.summary: Lazzaro highlights her work on civil rights ordinances and her success in securing $750,000 in state funding for pedestrian safety improvements at city rotaries.

items.title: Fire Department Funding
items.summary: The candidate advocates for using city free cash to fund a full dive team for the fire department to ensure water safety.

items.title: Economic Development and Zoning
items.summary: Lazzaro proposes reforming zoning laws to revitalize Medford Square and West Medford Square to increase city revenue.

items.title: School Infrastructure and Equity
items.summary: Lazzaro details her work on the High School Building Committee and her efforts to create an equitable fundraising alliance for elementary schools.

items.title: Platform and Vision
items.summary: The candidate concludes by pledging to prioritize infrastructure repairs and a community-centered approach to governance.
